The phone runs core’s JSON-RPC over this SSH
session. Nothing goes through the relay.

Add it to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the machine.
Check that the machine shows the same
fingerprint, then trust it. You only do this once.
Trust on first use: the fingerprint, the exact command to
check it on the machine, and Trust and connect.
The machine doesn't know this phone's key
yet. Add it, then try again.
The failing step is marked; the fix is a copyable one-liner with
this phone’s key, or switching to Tailscale SSH.
Linking needs internet. Machines on this
network can still be added over SSH.
